name: @knpkv/codecommit-web
description: Web server and frontend for CodeCommit PR browser

scripts.predev: pnpm --filter @knpkv/browser-pairing build && pnpm --filter "@knpkv/relay-product..." build && pnpm --filter "@knpkv/review..." build && pnpm build
scripts.prestart: pnpm --filter @knpkv/browser-pairing build && pnpm --filter "@knpkv/relay-product..." build && pnpm --filter "@knpkv/review..." build && pnpm build
scripts.dev: tsc -b ../codecommit-core && node ../../scripts/require-built.mjs @knpkv/codecommit-core && (tsc -b ../codecommit-core --watch --preserveWatchOutput & CODECOMMIT_WEB_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173 bun run --watch src/main.ts & vite --clearScreen false)
scripts.check: tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.roles.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --filter "@knpkv/browser-pairing" build && pnpm --filter "@knpkv/relay-product..." build && pnpm --filter "@knpkv/review..." build && pnpm --filter "@knpkv/codecommit-core..." build && pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
